[SWS_EM_02296] Request of a state transition to a state that the Function Group is already in transition to
⌈
After successful validation of a ara::exec::
StateClient::SetState call for a Function Group that is already under state
transition, Execution Management shall:
• set the ara::core::Future of the previous request to kCancelled if there is
one
• return a new ara::core::Future for the new request
• continue the ongoing Function Group state transition
⌋
